records.source: Hello, it's nice to meet you. $h#$e#You picked a good time to move here... The spring is lovely.
records.translation: Kumusta, ikinagagalak kitang makilala. $h#$e#Magandang panahon ang pinili mo para lumipat dito... Kaibig-ibig ang tagsibol.

records.source: Oh, wow... I had a sip of this stuff when I was a kid, and I've never forgotten the taste.
records.translation: Ah, wow... Nakatikim ako nito noong bata pa ako, at hindi ko kailanman nalimutan ang lasa.

records.source: Hey, thanks a bunch, @! This makes my birthday feel special.$h
records.translation: Hoy, maraming salamat, @! Dahil dito ay naging espesyal ang kaarawan ko.$h

records.source: You want to dance with me? Yes!$h#$e#I was wondering if you'd ask me...$h
records.translation: Gusto mong makipagsayaw sa akin? Oo!$h#$e#Iniisip ko kung yayayain mo ako...$h

records.source: I had a feeling you would ask me...$l
records.translation: May kutob akong yayayain mo ako...$l

records.source: Elliott's a real romantic... I'm sure your days will be filled with poetry!$h
records.translation: Talagang romantiko si Elliott... Sigurado akong mapupuno ng tula ang mga araw mo!$h

records.source: I'm happy that Shane's in such a good place. I've never seen him smile so much!#$e#With his love for chickens, I'm sure he'll fit right in on %farm Farm!$h
records.translation: Masaya akong napabuti nang husto ang kalagayan ni Shane. Ngayon ko lang siya nakitang ngumiti nang ganito kadalas!#$e#Dahil mahilig siya sa mga manok, sigurado akong babagay siya sa %farm Farm!$h
records.englishResidueReason: The literal “Farm” is part of the protected %farm Farm runtime substitution form and must remain unchanged.

records.source: Oh! Thank you! This one has an interesting shape...$h
records.translation: Oh! Salamat! Kawili-wili ang hugis nito...$h

records.source: Hey, where'd you find that? *sniff*... Mmm... This will be perfect, grated over a fresh pasta. Thank you!$h
records.translation: Hoy, saan mo iyan nakita? *Singhot*... Mmm... Perpekto itong gadgarin sa ibabaw ng bagong lutong pasta. Salamat!$h

records.source: Mmm... Back in the city, the veggies never tasted this fresh. I love it!$h
records.translation: Mmm... Noong nasa lungsod ako, hindi kailanman ganito kasariwa ang lasa ng mga gulay. Gustung-gusto ko ito!$h

records.source: $c 0.8#This looks delicious... Thank you! There's nothing quite like a fresh, wild salad.$h#Oh, wow, @! This is exactly what I was craving! How'd you know?$h
records.translation: $c 0.8#Mukhang masarap ito... Salamat! Walang katulad ang salad ng mga sariwang halamang ligaw.$h#Oh, wow, @! Ito mismo ang pinananabikan ko! Paano mo nalaman?$h

records.source: Please don't feel like you have to spend all your time with me now that we're dating... I know you're a busy person!
records.translation: Huwag mong isiping kailangan mong gugulin sa akin ang lahat ng oras mo ngayong magkasintahan na tayo... Alam kong abala ka!

records.source: I sold enough art at that show to get by for another year... that's all I needed!
records.translation: Sapat ang naibenta kong mga likhang-sining sa palabas na iyon para mabuhay nang isa pang taon... iyon lang ang kailangan ko!

records.source: I'm still fuming about the picnic... what a weirdo!$a#$b#Let's never talk about... that person... ever again.$s
records.translation: Galit na galit pa rin ako tungkol sa piknik... napakakakatwa ng taong iyon!$a#$b#Huwag na nating pag-usapan... ang taong iyon... kahit kailan.$s

records.source: If my art continues to sell online like it has, I'll be able to keep making art forever. That's always been my dream.
records.translation: Kung patuloy na mabenta nang ganito ang sining ko sa internet, makagagawa ako ng sining habambuhay. Iyon ang matagal ko nang pangarap.

records.source: Don't tell anyone, but Willy let me steer the boat for a few minutes.$h
records.translation: Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman, pero pinatimon sa akin ni Willy ang bangka nang ilang minuto.$h

records.source: Well, that was deeply relaxing.
records.translation: Aba, talagang nakapagpaginhawa iyon.

records.source: I love the weather in Stardew Valley, but seeing a different climate now and then helps put things into perspective.
records.translation: Gustung-gusto ko ang panahon sa Stardew Valley, pero nakatutulong ang makakita paminsan-minsan ng ibang klima upang makita ang mga bagay sa ibang pananaw.

records.source: The shape of the waves here is awe inspiring.#$e#I wonder if I could ever capture that sort of formlessness in a sculpture.
records.translation: Kagila-gilalas ang hugis ng mga alon dito.#$e#Iniisip ko kung makukuha ko kaya sa isang eskultura ang ganoong kawalan ng tiyak na anyo.

records.source: I like the heat as long as I'm keeping perfectly still.$h
records.translation: Gusto ko ang init basta hindi talaga ako gumagalaw.$h

records.source: Mmm, I bet the trees around here would make for an interesting medium to work with.#$e#Though Willy probably wouldn't be happy with me if I dragged a bunch of logs onto his ship!$h
records.translation: Mmm, palagay ko'y magiging kawili-wiling materyal ang mga puno rito.#$e#Pero malamang ay hindi matutuwa si Willy kung magkakaladkad ako ng maraming troso papunta sa barko niya!$h

records.source: I wonder what kind of things you could forage out here.#$e#I think I saw some tasty looking walnuts growing on a bush nearby.
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung anong mga bagay ang maaaring makalap dito.#$e#Parang may nakita akong walnut na mukhang masarap at tumutubo sa isang palumpong sa malapit.

records.source: Have you tried the Piña Colada? I'm on my second one... hehe.
records.translation: Natikman mo na ba ang Piña Colada? Ikalawang baso ko na ito... hehe.

records.source: Finally! I was starting to get worried you wanted to dance with someone else!$h
records.translation: Sa wakas! Nagsisimula na akong mag-alalang gusto mong sumayaw sa iba!$h

records.source: I'll be honest. I don't want to dance with you.$u
records.translation: Sa totoo lang, Ayaw kong makipagsayaw sa iyo.$u

records.source: I've realized I'm happier by myself. So just leave me be.$u
records.translation: Napagtanto kong mas masaya ako nang mag-isa. Kaya hayaan mo na lang ako.$u

records.source: Ohh... Got it. Hah... I really don't have any luck when it comes to this stuff...$s
records.translation: Ohh... Nauunawaan ko. Hah... Talagang wala akong suwerte pagdating sa ganitong bagay...$s

records.source: I don't want to see you for a while...$s
records.translation: Ayaw muna kitang makita...$s

records.source: You caused a lot of grief with what you did... but I'm ready to put the past behind us.$s
records.translation: Nagdulot ng matinding dalamhati ang ginawa mo... pero handa na akong iwan sa nakaraan ang nangyari.$s

records.source: I came for the sound of the ocean. Beautiful, isn't it?
records.translation: Pumunta ako rito para sa tunog ng karagatan. Maganda, hindi ba?

records.source: The trees look nice today, don't they?#$q 21/22/211132 Mon_old#So why did you become a farmer?#$r 21 -5 Mon_21#I want to make tons of money.#$r 22 5 Mon_22#It's more "real" than living in the city.#$r 211132 5 Mon_211132#To follow in Grandpa's footsteps.#$r 22 5 Mon_22#I wanted to escape my old life.
records.translation: Maganda ang mga puno ngayon, hindi ba?#$q 21/22/211132 Mon_old#Kaya bakit ka naging magsasaka?#$r 21 -5 Mon_21#Gusto kong kumita ng napakaraming pera.#$r 22 5 Mon_22#Mas “tunay” ito kaysa manirahan sa lungsod.#$r 211132 5 Mon_211132#Upang sundan ang yapak ni Lolo.#$r 22 5 Mon_22#Gusto kong takasan ang dati kong buhay.

records.source: $p 21#So are you making as much money as you hoped?|Spending time in nature is very rewarding.
records.translation: $p 21#Kumita ka ba nang kasindami ng inaasahan mo?|Napakasiya-siya ng paggugol ng oras sa kalikasan.

records.source: Hmm. That seems kind of shallow, doesn't it?$s
records.translation: Hmm. Parang mababaw iyon, hindi ba?$s

records.source: Hey... That's pretty much the reason I came here, too!$h#$b#I wanted to connect with nature more...
records.translation: Hoy... Halos iyan din ang dahilan kung bakit ako pumunta rito!$h#$b#Gusto kong mas mapalapit sa kalikasan...

records.source: That's very sweet to honor your grandfather like that.
records.translation: Napakabuti mong parangalan si Lolo sa ganoong paraan.

records.source: Where did all these plants come from? It's a surprise, but I'm not complaining...
records.translation: Saan nanggaling ang lahat ng halamang ito? Nakagugulat, pero hindi ako nagrereklamo...

records.source: I guess everyone in town was scared of that strange rain? I had no idea... I just thought it was incredible!$h
records.translation: Natakot yata ang lahat sa bayan sa kakaibang ulang iyon? Wala akong kaalam-alam... Akala ko lang ay kamangha-mangha iyon!$h

records.source: Imagine if this rain lasted all summer... The plants would take over the entire valley!
records.translation: Isipin mo kung tumagal ang ulang ito sa buong tag-init... Sasakupin ng mga halaman ang buong lambak!

records.source: Hi. Oh, you want to talk?#$e#The landscape around here gives me a lot of ideas. The terrain is almost like a sculpture itself.#$e#I don't make art for money. It's just an urge that I have.#$e#Farming seems like a very rewarding profession. You get to create delicious food for everyone!$h#$e#You're probably busy. Sorry.
records.translation: Kumusta. Oh, gusto mong makipag-usap?#$e#Marami akong nakukuhang ideya mula sa tanawin dito. Ang mismong lupain ay halos parang isang eskultura.#$e#Hindi ako lumilikha ng sining para sa pera. Isa lang itong udyok na nasa loob ko.#$e#Mukhang napakasiya-siyang propesyon ang pagsasaka. Nakalilikha ka ng masasarap na pagkain para sa lahat!$h#$e#Malamang ay abala ka. Paumanhin.

records.source: Hello, neighbor.#$e#We both live outside of town. Does that mean something?
records.translation: Kumusta, kapitbahay.#$e#Pareho tayong nakatira sa labas ng bayan. May kahulugan kaya iyon?

records.source: #$1 LeahBug#This morning I accidentally stepped on a bug.$s#$e#Sometimes I think it's impossible to live without destroying nature in some way.
records.translation: #$1 LeahBug#Hindi ko sinasadyang maapakan ang isang kulisap kaninang umaga.$s#$e#Minsan ay naiisip kong imposibleng mabuhay nang hindi sinisira ang kalikasan sa anumang paraan.

records.source: I love being around animals. They're so innocent.#$e#Farm animals are wonderful, too.$h
records.translation: Gustung-gusto kong makasama ang mga hayop. Napakawalang-malay nila.#$e#Kahanga-hanga rin ang mga hayop sa bukid.$h

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#It must be satisfying to harvest a whole field of crops, huh? You're basically creating food out of nothing!$h|Hi @! I was just thinking about you and your farm.#$e#I was imagining how good it must feel to harvest a big bunch of crops.$h#$e#Wouldn't it be nice to have help, though?$l
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Tiyak na kasiya-siyang umani ng isang buong taniman, ano? Para ka na ring lumilikha ng pagkain mula sa wala!$h|Kumusta, @! Iniisip lang kita at ang bukid mo.#$e#Iniisip ko kung gaano kasarap sa pakiramdam ang umani ng napakaraming pananim.$h#$e#Pero masarap din sigurong may katulong, hindi ba?$l

records.source: There's actually a lot of wild food in this area, if you know where to look.#$e#I've been having fresh salads almost every day.$h
records.translation: Marami talagang ligaw na pagkain sa lugar na ito, kung alam mo kung saan hahanapin.#$e#Halos araw-araw akong kumakain ng sariwang salad.$h

records.source: Foraging is a specialty of mine. Someday I'll make you a fresh salad.$h
records.translation: Dalubhasa ako sa pangangalap. Balang araw ay gagawan kita ng sariwang salad.$h

records.source: It's simpler to be friends with the trees. They don't have much to say.$h
records.translation: Mas madaling kaibiganin ang mga puno. Wala silang gaanong sinasabi.$h

records.source: We wouldn't be able to survive without nature. It's good to remember that.
records.translation: Hindi tayo mabubuhay nang wala ang kalikasan. Mabuting tandaan iyon.

records.source: Hello, @. It's a nice day, isn't it?#$e#Stop by my cabin if you ever need someone to talk to.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Maganda ang araw, hindi ba?#$e#Dumaan ka sa Kubo ko kung kailangan mo ng makakausap.$h
